spec.kitLine: Enter Burst Stage 1, self, MP is 0: MP +1
spec.assertion: Structural: a skill1 block with trigger stageEnter/stage 1, target self, a positive resource delta, and resourceGate.max === 0. Fails under the nearest-wrong readings: keying to her OWN burstCast (she is Burst III, never the stage-1 caster) or dropping the MP-is-0 gate so the pool gains every rotation.

spec.kitLine: Enter Full Burst, self, MP above 1: MP +1
spec.assertion: Structural: a skill1 fullBurstEnter block, target self, positive resource delta, resourceGate.min >= 1. Fails under a burstCast keying (which would under-fire in a two-Burst-III comp) and under an ungated gain. FLAG: read literally, MP > 1 can never be satisfied because the stage-1 line only fires at MP 0 and stops at 1 - the pool would stall forever. The only self-consistent reading is a floor of >= 1, so the assertion permits min 1 or 2.

spec.kitLine: All MP consumed on Burst Skill
spec.assertion: Structural: some block carries a resource effect with delta <= -12, i.e. a spend that covers the whole pool. Fails under a partial spend (e.g. -1 per cast) or under no spend at all, which would let MP monotonically climb to the cap and permanently over-credit the MP-scaled burst.

Structural: chargeCounter trigger with count 6, target self, buff targetMaxHpPct 6.34 / durationSec 15 / maxStacks 10. Behavioural: >= 5 self maxHpFlat buffApply events in 180s with maxStacks 10 and observed stacks never above 10. Counterfactual: patching the counter threshold to 1 must multiply the grant count by more than 2.5x - RED if the threshold is not actually read (shotFired or hitCount encodings) . NOTE: at RL cadence (60f charge, 6 ammo, 141f reload) one grant lands roughly every magazine, so with a 15s window only ~1-2 stacks coexist; the 10-stack cap is unreachable in a 180s fight and is deliberately not asserted as reached.

Zeroing the 6.34% targetMaxHpPct value must LOWER her total damage while leaving every teammate byte-identical. Fails under the nearest-wrong models: the Max HP line dropped as defensive-only, or encoded as maxHpPct/casterMaxHpPct from a non-self caster so it never feeds her own atkOfMaxHpPct conversion. This is the only line in the kit whose damage relevance is purely indirect, so it is the one most likely to be silently skipped.

Structural: target alliesOfElement/Electric with excludeSelf true; trigger is stageEnter or fullBurstEnter (the two lines that REPLENISH MP), never burstCast (which SPENDS it); payload elemAdvantageDamagePct 40.9 / 10s plus casterAtkPct 20.9 / 10s. Behavioural: zero buffApply events of elemAdvantageDamagePct value 40.9 target her - RED under a plain allies target without excludeSelf.

Structural: target self, trigger burstCast (or fullBurstEnter with ownBurstGate 'cast'), atkOfMaxHpPct 3.2 / 10s and elemAdvantageDamagePct 31.68 / 10s. Behavioural: both self buffs apply the same number of times, at their RAW percentages (atkOfMaxHpPct is not a flat-resolved stat). Counterfactual: re-keying the block to a bare fullBurstEnter must INCREASE the apply count - the control comp's second Burst III is what makes the two triggers diverge, so a bare fullBurstEnter encoding over-credits every rotation the other Burst III takes.

Structural: chargeCounter count 1, target enemy, flatDamage atkPct 547.62, core not set (the text says damage, not core strike damage). Behavioural: zeroing it drops her total below 85% of baseline while teammates stay byte-identical; re-keying the counter to 6 also drops her total. Fails if the rider is missing, is core-flagged, or fires on a slower cadence than one per full charge. NOT asserted: noRange, which the engine force-sets for riders rather than the override.

LIVE: the burst slot carries an enemy-targeted flatDamage of at least 1372.8% and zeroing it lowers her total with no teammate movement. SKIPPED: the 10%-of-final-Max-HP addend - flatDamage is a percentage of final ATK only, and the addend should track the skill1 Max HP stacks, which a static atkPct cannot do. Any bake-in is a flagged estimate.

spec.kitLine: Attacks repeatedly based on current MP
spec.assertion: SKIPPED. flatDamage has no perResource hook, so an MP-scaled hit COUNT is expressible only as N resourceGate-tiered duplicate blocks or as a baked constant reflecting an assumed steady-state MP. Both are defensible; asserting either would test the chosen encoding rather than the kit. The steady-state MP itself is outside the prose's input domain (it depends on rotation count and how often she is the Burst III that casts), so it is a flag-value, not a derivable one.

Structural: both 40.9 and 31.68 sit on elemAdvantageDamagePct and NO attackDamagePct buff exists anywhere in the kit. Behavioural: zeroing every elemAdvantageDamagePct value leaves every unit's total byte-identical, because she is Electric and the control boss is Fire (no advantage). RED under the nearest-wrong encoding - a generic attackDamagePct Damage-Up buff - which would credit her against a boss she holds no advantage over.

fixtures: controlComp('maiden-ice-rose', true) for every run - liter Burst I / crown Burst II / maiden-ice-rose Burst III / helm Burst III vs the Fire boss, deterministic (no seed). The fixed second Burst III is kept ON deliberately: it is the only thing that makes own-burst-cast diverge in count from team full-burst-enter, which is what discriminates the skill2 MP-used trigger; a lone Burst III would cast no bursts at all. The Fire boss additionally gives a free, high-value inertness check, since Electric holds no advantage against Fire and every elemAdvantageDamagePct point must therefore be damage-neutral here. 8 hoisted runs: baseline plus 7 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (Max HP value zeroed, Max HP counter threshold 6 -> 1, skill2 rider zeroed, skill2 rider counter 1 -> 6, burst flat damage zeroed, both advantage buffs zeroed, MP-used trigger re-keyed to bare fullBurstEnter). All counterfactuals mutate the in-memory clone via the slot arrays (ov.skill1 / ov.skill2 / ov.burst); no committed JSON is touched and nothing is written under src/skills/overrides.
gaps: burst 'Attacks repeatedly based on current MP' - it.skip: flatDamage has no perResource hook, so a live MP-scaled hit count needs either N resourceGate-tiered duplicate blocks or a baked steady-state constant; asserting one encoding would test the encoding, not the kit. Steady-state MP is a flag-value (outside the prose's input domain).

burst '10% of the skill user's final Max HP' addend - it.skip: flatDamage is a percentage of final ATK only, and this addend should grow with the skill1 Max HP stacks, which a static atkPct cannot track.

skill2 40.9% / caster-ATK 20.9% ally-side magnitude - it.skip: the control comp's Electric membership is not knowable from the kit prose, so an ally-side magnitude assertion risks being vacuous. Only the excludeSelf half is asserted (non-vacuous either way).

FLAG - skill1b 'MP is above 1': taken literally (MP >= 2) the pool stalls at 1 forever, because skill1a only fires at MP 0. The test only requires resourceGate.min >= 1; the exact floor (1 vs 2) needs the datamined condition or in-game observation.
FLAG - the 10-stack cap on the 6.34% Max HP buff is unreachable at RL cadence (~1 grant per magazine cycle vs a 15s window), so live stacks sit at ~1-2. Asserted as stacks <= 10, not as reaching 10.

NOT asserted - rider noRange and burst full-burst exemption: per the stated engine conventions these are engine-side defaults (riders force no-range; a burst cast lands before the Full Burst window opens), not override fields, so an override-level assertion would be testing the wrong layer.
